title: Cayson Acquisition Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: Cayson Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq (tickers CAPNU/CAPN/CAPNR), filed this 8-K to report that insiders deposited a $125,000 contribution on April 22, 2026 for the second month of an extension to find a business combination. The extension allows the company to delay consummation of an initial business combination until March 23, 2027, provided insiders contribute $125,000 per month.
key_points: Cayson Acquisition Corp held an extraordinary general meeting on March 18, 2026 to approve extension amendments
The amendment allows monthly extension of the business combination deadline up to March 23, 2027
Insiders must contribute $125,000 per month utilized to extend the timeline
Contributions are deposited into the Trust Account and increase per-share redemption price
The second monthly contribution was deposited on April 22, 2026
Company is registered in the Cayman Islands and trades on Nasdaq under CAPNU, CAPN, CAPNR
